educationalGoal: The goal of this course is to have one's own view of education through a fundamental study of education. To that end, based on educational theory, clarify the actual issues of school education, home education, and social education, and cultivate the basic ability to think about future education.
advice: This course covers the items as below. 1. What is “Education”? The history of school education The establishment of modern school, The issues of school education 4. Lifelong education The significance of lifelong education, Home education and social education 5. The issues of the current education Education in cooperation with community, The future education
